scope: Manual review of the final post-fix results.json against the labelled PDF pages and retrieved excerpts.

cases.notes: Keyword retrieval did not return PDF page 130 or another passage containing the consolidated $130,497 million value in the returned set. Evidence was marked sufficient from related fiscal-2025 revenue passages, so the exact-value citation requirement failed.
Keyword retrieval favored proxy-compensation passages containing non-GAAP operating-income terminology and did not return the page-130 consolidated value.
PDF pages 18-19 support rounded fiscal-2025 revenue and the 114% increase, but not both exact endpoints in the reference answer; claim verification correctly rejected the exact claim.
Retrieved passages cover Hopper/AI demand and Ethernet contributions with valid source pages.
Expanded hybrid retrieval reached the relevant supply and transition risk section; the reference claim and citation were verified.
Related debt/equity passages were weak evidence, the explicitly requested ratio was absent, and the system abstained after bounded expansion.
The ambiguity detector requested clarification rather than choosing a profit definition, and the system abstained.

Observed evidence status was weak rather than the labelled insufficient because related revenue passages existed; the requested 2030 revenue remained missing and the final decision correctly abstained.
Bounded expansion retrieved the $47,061 million passage and the reference claim/citation verified.
Keyword proximity reranking retrieved the operating-income disclosure and the reference claim/citation verified.
Hybrid retrieval found the 21.2% and 24.7% operating-margin table and verification succeeded.
Hybrid retrieval returned the stated operating-income drivers on PDF pages 51-52 and the claim verified.

Revenue evidence was retrieved, but the page-7 33.7/33.3 billion unit-case values were not. Evidence sufficiency was overly permissive because other unit-volume percentages occurred in the retrieved passages; claim verification correctly rejected the combined reference claim.
Component debt/equity evidence remained weak without an explicitly reported ratio, and the final policy abstained.
The broad performance question was recognized as ambiguous and the system abstained after bounded retrieval.
Observed status was weak rather than insufficient due to related revenue passages; 2026 revenue remained missing and the final policy correctly abstained.

method_note: Manual statuses are qualitative review labels, not additional automatically measured metrics. The automatic metrics remain those in results.json.
